items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: We just had a birthday celebration for him. Lots of the trombone players came out, the guys from the symphony, local trombone players, and there’s Harold, in his nineties.

ctx.x: I have this — when we started this project back in 1995, I remember someone saying, “Well you should go interview Harold Betters, the world’s loudest trombone player.” I said, “Really? The world’s loudest trombone player.” He was a Pittsburgh —
He’s still there. We just had a birthday celebration for him. Lots of the trombone players came out, the guys from the symphony, local trombone players, and there’s Harold, in his nineties.
